digest.component_or_area: LLM model class system and config resolution
propositions: The single REBAR_LLM_MODEL scalar cannot express per-pass model tier selection, causing Pass-2/Pass-4 downgrade to silently stop applying when non-default providers are used.
Plan-review Pass-1 model ladder with bare Anthropic names resolves to direct Anthropic provider even on Bedrock-configured runs, creating a split-brain routing in the pass performing 41 of 42 calls.

Class names in YAML (trivial/standard/frontier) must resolve through exactly three call sites: step model selection, batch ladder expansion, and verifier path selection; a single resolution function prevents drift.
Config layering must deep-merge tables (preserving sibling keys) and replace arrays wholly, so an environment override of one class field does not require restating the entire class configuration.

The reserved-value mechanism keeps the workflow step schema closed and immutable by treating class names as valid values in the existing model-string space, avoiding fork of step schema into two mutually exclusive keys.
